title: Research code and replay data for QRS-independent P-wave augmentation in ECG delineation
description:
Research software and derived event counts for QRS-independent P-wave augmentation and cross-database ECG delineation in pathological rhythms.

The archive includes the training-source snapshot, the analysis code and the frozen counts for the 48-segment BUT PDB benchmark and exploratory European ST-T subset of QTDB. The replay covers the four primary architecture comparisons, external comparisons and rhythm subgroup counts. Source-dataset attribution and reuse terms are documented in DATA_SOURCES.md.
